name: AMEGO-X
full_name: All-sky Medium Energy Gamma-ray Observatory eXplorer
summary: AMEGO-X is an independently named MIDEX-scale concept for a proposed low Earth orbit. The website's old “launch before 2028” statement was an original proposal target, not a currently approved schedule.
detection_principle: AstroPix monolithic silicon pixels and a CsI calorimeter reconstruct photoelectric, Compton and pair-conversion events, mapping all-sky gamma rays to constrain low-mass dark-matter models.

status.label: The 2021 MIDEX proposal received no further mission funding; component development continued in 2025 with plans to resubmit

key_parameters.value: About 100 keV–1 GeV; transient triggering down to about 25 keV

key_parameters.name: Baseline mission concept
key_parameters.value: 3 years; near-all-sky coverage every two orbits, both design values

results.summary: Vector–scalar-portal studies forecast AMEGO-X and COSI sensitivity to sub-GeV dark matter; these are not exclusions.

science_scope: Searches cosmic gamma-ray, antiparticle or neutrino spectra, directions and fluxes for indirect signatures of dark-matter annihilation, decay or related new physics. Conventional astrophysical sources and propagation can produce similar signals, requiring background modeling; design sensitivity is not a measured limit or discovery.
